g.text: The owner writes one brief. Nothing else is asked yet.
The writer anchors each requirement in the north star and gives an example with real values.
The lint checks terms, EARS form, anchors and examples.
Gate H1: the owner approves what done means. This is the only approval.
Task 0 turns the examples into tests. Each test must fail first.
The implementer extends a module from the map. It writes no new client.
The script runs the checks. The model cannot skip them.
A different model reviews scope, the ponytail ladder and reuse.
Accept verifies by machine. Nobody approves by eye.
Merge. The module map and the north star learn what the slice proved.
